description: A smooth tenor pitch from a man in his 40s - perfect for agentic use cases.

name: Bella - Professional, Bright, Warm
description: This voice is warm, bright, and professional, characterized by a Standard American accent and a polished, narrative quality. It features a medium-high pitch with crisp diction and a deliberate, rhythmic pace that makes it highly intelligible and engaging for long-form listening.

name: Chris - Charming, Down-to-Earth
description: Natural and real, this down-to-earth voice is great across many use-cases.

name: Brian - Deep, Resonant and Comforting
description: Middle-aged man with a resonant and comforting tone. Great for narrations and advertisements.

name: Daniel - Steady Broadcaster
description: A strong voice perfect for delivering a professional broadcast or news story.

name: Lily - Velvety Actress
description: Velvety British female voice delivers news and narrations with warmth and clarity.

name: Adam - Dominant, Firm
description: A bright tenor pitch that immediately cuts through. The delivery is brash and openly confident, speaking with unwavering certainty and a slightly aggressive self-assurance.

name: Bill - Wise, Mature, Balanced
description: Friendly and comforting voice ready to narrate your stories.

name: DYLO - Dark Anime Hero
description: Young adult male, fierce voice.

name: Danit - Natural Israeli Hebrew
description: A native Israeli female voice speaking Hebrew in a natural, conversational style. Well suited to personal storytelling, podcasts, educational videos, and everyday dialogue. An approachable voice with an authentic Israeli accent and a personal, relatable delivery.

name: Jett - Gritty, Spunky Young Hero
description: A young hero with a bit of an edge to him. He could fight demons or host your podcast!

name: Michael Dalton - Modern Male Lead
description: Cool, charismatic, all-American 20-something voice with natural confidence, subtle emotional depth, and a grounded, relatable tone. Ideal for audiobooks, video games, animation, and character-driven content — especially young male leads, teen protagonists, athletes, high school or college students, and coming-of-age stories. Perfect for storytelling, dialogue, and voiceover projects that need a modern, cinematic feel with just the right edge.

name: Max - USA Energetic Animated Cartoon
description: Max is a high-energy, versatile American character voice engineered specifically for animation, social media, gaming, and dynamic commercial content. Delivering punchy articulation, vibrant dynamic range, and cinematic presence, Max is built to bring animated leads, zany cartoon heroes, and fast-paced social media promos to life. Recorded in a broadcast-spec booth with a pristine signal chain for zero-lag, studio-grade renders every time.

name: Lukas - Excited youthful young man
description: Young man with a lot of passion and excitement in tone, happy, hopeful and confident. Good for characters and catchy Socil Media narration.

name: Itamar - Israeli Hebrew Narrator
description: A native Israeli Hebrew speaker with a clear, natural male voice, measured pacing, and a conversational delivery. His distinctly Israeli sound suits educational videos, online courses, tutorials, explainers, and documentary-style narration. Professional and approachable, with subtle expression that makes detailed content easy to follow.

name: Noku
description: Inspired by a heroic male anime character. The main protagonist in an action-packed anime story or animated action cartoon.

name: Little Dude II - Cartoon Character
description:
A high-pitched, energetic cartoon-style voice with a playful, mischievous edge.
The delivery has a light Southern drawl, giving the voice a quirky regional flavor and a hint of friendly rural warmth.
Expressive emphasis, comedic timing, and exaggerated intonation patterns make the voice perfect for humorous characters, sidekicks, or whimsical narrators.
Bright, fast, and slightly raspy at the top end, elongated vowels, and lively emotional swings.

name: Austin Boy
description: A young American timid orphan boy. Tone is soft. Voice works well for characters & Animation.

name: Teddy Twinkle - Cute Cartoon Boy
description: A sweet, playful, and adorable little cartoon boy inspired by popular kids' characters. He is kind, cheerful, and lovable. Ideal for children's animations, kids' audiobooks, storybook apps, educational content, and social media.

name: VALF - Child, Young, Playful & Sarcastic
description: A very Young voice with an energetic, playful. Perfect for cartoons, animation, anime dubbing, video games, children's content,  videos, narration, and character acting. Ideal for kid characters, young heroes, mischievous boys, and expressive character performances.

name: Nimrod - Warm and Confident
description: A natural, warm and confident Israeli male voice with clear native Hebrew pronunciation and an engaging, conversational tone.  Versatile and expressive, with a smooth, friendly delivery that works beautifully for storytelling, narration, commercials, educational content, podcasts and social media videos.  Authentic, approachable and professional, with a distinctly Israeli character.

name: Super VM – Ang Boses ng Pag-asa at mga Hindi Naririnig
description:
He sounds like a brave  Super VoiceMaster with a heart full of dreams and a voice that cuts through silence.
His tone is bright, hopeful, and filled with emotional sincerity—like a man, who’s been quiet for a long time but finally found the courage to speak for himself and for others. Filipino, Voice Hero Hero, Cute But Brave, Tagalog VO, Young Narrator, Empowering, Inspiring Man, Real and Relatable, Superhero Voice.

name: Kai - Energetic Anime Hero
description: Bright, mid-high young male with tons of energy and personality. Perfect for anime-style protagonists and main leads. He can be goofy and nerdy one moment, then loud, proud and fully determined the next. Great for animation, video game heroes, quirky sidekicks, fan dubs and fun character content.

name: VALF - Anime Protagonist Charismatic
description: Youthful, expressive anime protagonist voice with natural charm, curiosity, determination, and emotion. Versatile from casual, playful dialogue to intense battles, dramatic speeches, heartfelt scenes, and emotional moments. Perfect for anime, animation, games, RPGs, visual novels, storytelling, and character skits. Ideal for young heroes, adventurous protagonists, energetic leads, aspiring warriors, supernatural characters, and relatable anime characters.

name: Edrin Silversong - The Curious Alchemist
description: A teenage alchemist whose journey is as much inward as it is out in the mysterious lands he explores. His personality is a blend of curiosity, resilience, and compassion, shaped by his transformative journey from a young, ambitious seeker of power to a wise, reflective soul. Resilient, brave, compassionate, kind, inquisitive, intelligent, humble, reflective, and spiritually grounded.

name: Aaron - Conversational American Male
description: Youthful, earnest American male voice with natural boy-next-door charm. Bright, energetic, and conversational with an authentic, relatable quality — the friendly young hero type. Perfect for animation, video game characters, explainers, tech content, teen and young adult audiobooks, and upbeat commercials. Clean studio recording from a professional video producer. Neutral American accent.
